name: Taurus Identity
description: Defines Taurus as a stabilizing sign modifier and establishes ontology boundaries.

identityConstraints: Taurus may not function as an actor.
Taurus may not replace a planetary or angular verb.
Taurus may not determine an outcome.
Taurus may not be reduced to a personality trait.
Taurus may not imply materialism, stubbornness, or laziness by default.
Taurus must remain traceable to approved modifier domains.

distinctions.venus: Venus is an actor with its own canonical function; Taurus is a modifier.
distinctions.earth_element: Earth is a family-level classification; Taurus is a specific modifier ontology.
distinctions.fixed_modality: Fixed is a modality classification; Taurus adds sign-specific stabilization semantics.
distinctions.virgo: Virgo modifies through discrimination, adjustment, and refinement; Taurus modifies through continuity and consolidation.
distinctions.capricorn: Capricorn modifies through structure, sequencing, and long-range organization; Taurus modifies through preservation and durable maintenance.
